sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: GIVEN THE CURRENT BLOCKING PATTERN...THERE SHOULD BE LITTLE CHANGE TO THE LARGE-SCALE MID/UPPER FLOW REGIME ACROSS THE U.S. THROUGH THIS FORECAST PERIOD. MODELS DO SUGGEST AT LEAST SOME SUPPRESSION OF LOW AMPLITUDE RIDGING NOW BUILDING WITHIN A BELT OF WESTERLIES FROM THE NORTHERN GREAT BASIN INTO THE UPPER MIDWEST AND OHIO VALLEY...TO THE SOUTH OF A REMNANT CLOSED LOW JUST TO THE NORTH OF THE CENTRAL CANADIAN/U.S. BORDER. SLIGHT AMPLIFICATION OF DOWNSTREAM CYCLONIC FLOW ALSO APPEARS LIKELY ACROSS MID ATLANTIC COASTAL AREAS. IN GENERAL THOUGH...IT APPEARS MID-LEVEL HEIGHT CHANGES WILL BE WEAK. A PLUME OF WARMER...AND A BIT MORE STRONGLY CAPPING...ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE GRADUALLY ADVECTING NORTHEASTWARD THROUGH THE CENTRAL PLAINS. OTHERWISE...SOUTH OF A FRONTAL ZONE EXTENDING FROM THE SOUTHERN MID ATLANTIC COAST INTO THE GREAT LAKES REGION...ONLY SEASONABLY COOL MID-LEVEL TEMPERATURES WITH WEAK MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE EXPECTED ABOVE A SEASONABLY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER. WITH INSOLATION...HOWEVER...MODERATELY LARGE MIXED LAYER CAPE IS POSSIBLE BY LATE AFTERNOON ACROSS PARTS OF THE MID MISSISSIPPI INTO LOWER OHIO VALLEYS...AND ACROSS PARTS OF THE SOUTHEAST. ME

sections.title: PLAINS INTO OHIO VALLEY
sections.text: A REMNANT LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC IMPULSE...ASSOCIATED WITH THE ONGOING CLUSTER OF STORMS NOW SPREADING EASTWARD ACROSS THE MID MISSOURI VALLEY...IS EXPECTED TO PROGRESS ACROSS UPPER PORTIONS OF THE MIDDLE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY TODAY...WITHIN MODEST WEST NORTHWESTERLY FLOW. GIVEN THE BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION EXPECTED ACROSS EASTERN IOWA INTO NORTHERN/CENTRAL ILLINOIS AND INDIANA...IT SEEMS PROBABLE THAT ASSOCIATED FORCING WILL CONTRIBUTE TO NEW VIGOROUS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT...PERHAPS AS EARLY AS MID DAY. ALTHOUGH DETAILS ARE STILL UNCLEAR...WITH VERTICAL SHEAR EXPECTED TO BE WEAK...ONE OR TWO CLUSTERS OF STORMS COULD EVOLVE THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE DAY...WITH POTENTIAL FOR PRODUCING DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...PERHAPS SOME HAIL. DETAILS OF CONVECTIVE EVOLUTION BACK TO THE WEST...ACROSS THE NORTHERN AND CENTRAL PLAINS...ALSO REMAIN UNCLEAR. THIS IS MOSTLY DUE TO THE SUBTLE NATURE OF THE MID-LEVEL IMPULSES EXPECTED TO PROGRESS EAST OF THE ROCKIES...THROUGH THE CREST OF BROADER SCALE MID/UPPER RIDGING. GIVEN THE ANTICIPATED THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT...POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR FAIRLY INTENSE CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT BY LATE AFTERNOON. AND A SIGNAL EXISTS IN MOST MODEL GUIDANCE...SUPPORTED

sections.title: SOUTHERN MID ATLANTIC COASTAL AREAS
sections.text: DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW FIELDS AND SHEAR ARE EXPECTED TO REMAIN WEAK. HOWEVER...GIVEN THE CONTINUING PRESENCE OF A SEASONABLY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER...WHICH IS EXPECTED TO SUPPORT MODERATELY LARGE CAPE...FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH AN EAST SOUTHEASTWARD LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC WAVE MAY CONTRIBUTE TO CONSIDERABLE THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY TODAY ACROSS THE PIEDMONT INTO COASTAL PLAIN. WHILE THE RISK FOR SEVERE HAIL SEEMS NEGLIGIBLE...POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS MAY ACCOMPANY STRONGER STORMS. ..KERR/DEAN.. 06/21/2014

sections.title: NEB/SD/SE ND THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY TONIGHT
sections.text: THE OVERNIGHT CONVECTION ACROSS NEB IS NOW WEAKENING NEAR THE KS BORDER...WITH DESTABILIZATION EXPECTED THROUGH THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS NEB/SD/SRN ND WITH SURFACE HEATING AND A GRADUAL INCREASE IN LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE. STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES OBSERVED AT LBF AND RAP WILL CONTINUE TO OVERSPREAD NEB/SD TODAY...CONTRIBUTING TO MODERATE BUOYANCY BY MID-LATE AFTERNOON /MLCAPE OF 2000-3000 J PER KG/. THIS BUOYANCY...COMBINED WITH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR IN THE 30-40 KT RANGE...WILL SUPPORT A RISK FOR ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS...INCLUDING SUPERCELLS. THE INITIAL STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM THIS AFTERNOON ALONG A SUBTLE BOUNDARY FROM WRN/CENTRAL SD INTO SE ND...WHEN SUPERCELLS WITH ISOLATED VERY LARGE HAIL WILL BE MOST PROBABLE. CONVECTION SHOULD THEN GROW INTO ONE OR MORE CLUSTERS WHILE MOVING SEWD...WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS INTO THIS EVENING.

sections.title: IA/IL AREA TODAY
sections.text: A REMNANT MCV FROM OVERNIGHT CONVECTION WILL MOVE EWD/ESEWD FROM CENTRAL IA THIS MORNING TO NW IL BY EARLY AFTERNOON. SURFACE HEATING IN CLOUD BREAKS AND A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WILL SUPPORT MLCAPE APPROACHING 2000 J/KG THIS AFTERNOON IN ADVANCE OF THE MCV. SOME REGENERATION OF CONVECTION WILL BE POSSIBLE DURING THE AFTERNOON....WITH AN ASSOCIATED RISK FOR A FEW DAMAGING GUSTS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL.

sections.title: ERN NC/NE SC THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: A WEAK SURFACE FRONT/TROUGH WILL DRIFT SEWD ACROSS THE ERN CAROLINAS THIS AFTERNOON IN ASSOCIATION WITH DIFFUSE SPEED MAXIMA MOVING SEWD FROM THE OH VALLEY. THOUGH LAPSE RATES ALOFT ARE NOT PARTICULARLY STEEP IN REGIONAL 12Z SOUNDINGS...BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS NEAR 70 F AND DAYTIME HEATING WILL RESULT IN MODERATE BUOYANCY ACROSS THE ERN CAROLINAS. THE COMBINATION OF LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ALONG THE SURFACE TROUGH...AS WELL AS LOCAL SEA BREEZE CIRCULATIONS...COULD SUPPORT A FEW STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING DOWNBURST WINDS. ..THOMPSON/SMITH.. 06/21/2014

sections.text: STORMS ARE GRADUALLY INCREASING OVER EXTREME SERN WY/THE FAR WRN NEB PANHANDLE INTO EXTREME SWRN SD...IN ADVANCE OF A SHORT WAVE TROUGH MOVING TOWARD THE NRN ROCKIES. SEE MCD 1105 ISSUED AT 1923Z AND FORTHCOMING MCD 1106 FOR MORE SHORT-TERM DETAILS. HAVE ALSO EXPANDED THE SLIGHT RISK FARTHER SOUTH ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS OF ERN CO. WITH WIND PROFILES OVER THE FRONT RANGE INDICATE 30-35 KT DEEP LAYER SHEAR...CONVECTION FORMING OVER THE ERN SLOPES IS EXPECTED TO MOVE EWD INTO INCREASING INSTABILITY WITH POTENTIAL FOR LARGE HAIL AND STRONG WINDS WITH STRONGER CELLS.

sections.title: NRN AND CNTRL PLAINS
sections.text: THE LATEST WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS A SUBTLE UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE IN PLACE ACROSS THE UPPER MIDWEST WITH SEVERAL SHORTWAVE TROUGH IMPULSES UPSTREAM ACROSS THE NRN AND CNTRL PLAINS. AT THE SFC...A MESOLOW IS LOCATED IN NRN SD WHERE NUMEROUS STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING FROM NEAR MOBRIDGE EWD TO NEAR THE MN-SD STATE LINE. THIS ACTIVITY WAS LOCATED ON THE NWRN EDGE OF A CORRIDOR OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WITH SFC DEWPOINTS ACROSS THE ERN DAKOTAS IN THE LOWER TO MID 60S F. THIS WAS CONTRIBUTING TO A STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS ACROSS MUCH OF SD WHERE MLCAPE WAS ESTIMATED IN THE 2500 TO 3500 J/KG RANGE BY RAP-V2 MESOANALYSIS DATA. IN ADDITION TO THE STRONG INSTABILITY...THE ABERDEEN WSR-88D VWP SHOWS 0-6 KM SHEAR NEAR 40 KT SUGGESTING THE ENVIRONMENT WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT THIS EVENING. LARGE HAIL WILL BE COMMON WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS AND HAILSTONES OF GREATER THAN 2 INCHES IN DIAMETER WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE MORE INTENSE SUPERCELLS. AS THE MCS OVER SD CONTINUES TO ORGANIZE...A COLD POOL MAY DEVELOP AS CELLS MERGE EARLY THIS EVENING. THIS SHOULD INCREASE THE WIND DAMAGE THREAT TOWARD THE MID TO LATE EVENING. THE GREATEST CHANCE FOR WIND DAMAGE SHOULD BE LOCATED F

sections.title: MID MS VALLEY/SRN GREAT LAKES
sections.text: A SUBTLE SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY ACROSS THE MID MS VALLEY. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS ARE ONGOING NEAR THE TROUGH FROM ST LOUIS MO NEWD TO SOUTH BEND INDIANA. THIS ACTIVITY IS LOCATED IN A VERY MOIST AIRMASS WITH SFC DEWPOINTS FROM 65 TO 70 F ACROSS MUCH OF CNTRL IL AND NRN INDIANA. THE HIGH MOISTURE CONTENT WAS CONTRIBUTING TO MODERATE INSTABILITY ACROSS MUCH OF THE MID MS VALLEY. IN ADDITION...REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS AT NORTH WEBSTER AND SPRINGFIELD IL SHOW 0-6 KM SHEAR AROUND 30 KT WITH VEERED WIND PROFILES IN THE LOWEST 3 KM. THIS ALONG WITH THE MODERATE INSTABILITY MAY BE ENOUGH FOR AN ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE THREAT. THE THREAT WILL BE GREATEST ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF ANY BOWING LINE SEGMENT THAT CAN PERSIST AND MOVE SEWD ACROSS THE SLIGHT RISK AREA EARLY THIS EVENING. ..BROYLES.. 06/22/2014

mesoscale_discussions.summary: NUMEROUS STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS ACROSS THE REGION. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF A WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MULTIPLE FOCI FOR CONVECTIVE INITIATION WILL RESULT IN NUMEROUS STORMS THIS AFTERNOON. EVEN THOUGH MODERATE INSTABILITY /MLCAPE OVER 2000 J/KG/ IS DEVELOPING AS TEMPERATURES WARM...DEEP-LAYER FLOW/SHEAR IS RATHER WEAK. NEVERTHELESS...PW VALUES AT OR NEAR 2 INCHES IN THE PRESENCE OF STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES MAY SUPPORT ISOLATED WET MICROBURSTS. IN ADDITION...0-3 KM SHEAR AROUND 20 KTS /PER LOCAL VWP DATA/ COULD SUPPORT A COUPLE OF ORGANIZED CLUSTERS WITH A DAMAGING WIND THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP WITH A RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED AND A WW IS POSSIBLE PRIOR TO 19Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLD TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED ACROSS NRN IL AS OF 1730Z AS DAYTIME HEATING/DESTABILIZATION HAS EFFECTIVELY ELIMINATED CINH AND RESULTED IN A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS. MESOANALYSIS DEPICTED A NW-SE FRONTAL BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM SRN WI INTO NERN IL...AND A SURFACE CONFLUENCE ZONE EXTENDING FROM SWRN WI SWD ACROSS ERN IA AND NERN MO. ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS LIKELY IN THE VICINITY OF THESE BOUNDARIES...AIDED BY ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A REMNANT MCV MOVING EWD ACROSS NERN IA. BY MID-AFTN MLCAPE OF 2500 TO LOCALLY 3500 J/KG WILL BE IN PLACE...AND COMBINED WITH 30 - 35 KTS OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS AND ORGANIZED MULTICELLS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL. TSTMS MAY ORGANIZE INTO ONE OR MORE CLUSTERS WITH A LOCALLY ENHANCED SVR WIND THREAT. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED AND A WW IS POSSIBLE PRIOR TO 19Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON WITH A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. A WW IS LIKELY PRIOR TO 21Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLD TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED EARLY THIS AFTN ALONG A WEAK SURFACE BOUNDARY ACROSS SWRN SD AND SERN WY. STRONG INSTABILITY HAS DEVELOPED WITH AN AXIS OF MLCAPE IN EXCESS OF 3000 J/KG AHEAD OF THE BOUNDARY. A SHORTWAVE WILL MOVE EWD ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA THROUGH EARLY EVENING...AND WIND FIELDS WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS AND EVENTUALLY ONE OR MORE CLUSTERS OF STORMS. STEEP LAPSE RATES AND 35 TO 40 KTS OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR...ESPECIALLY OVER THE NORTHERN PORTION OF THE DISCUSSION AREA...SUGGEST THE POSSIBILITY OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO. LARGE TEMP-DEW POINT SPREADS WILL RESULT IN A DAMAGING WIND THREAT...ESPECIALLY OVER THE SRN PORTION OF THE AREA. A WW IS LIKELY PRIOR TO 21Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THIS AFTERNOON AND INTO EARLY EVENING. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE LIKELY AND A TORNADO WILL BE POSSIBLE. A WW IS POSSIBLE PRIOR TO 21Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED ALONG A PRE-FRONTAL SURFACE TROUGH EXTENDING FROM NWRN MN TO SOUTH-CENTRAL ND AS OF 1945Z. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS AN ENHANCED CUMULUS FIELD ELSEWHERE ALONG THIS TROUGH AND AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT...AND ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT APPEARS PROBABLE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. LOW-TO MID 60S DEW POINTS EXIST ACROSS THE AREA RESULTING IN MLCAPE AVERAGING 2000 TO 2500 J/KG WITH LITTLE REMAINING CINH. A SHORTWAVE WILL PROVIDE ADDITIONAL FORCING FOR ASCENT WITH TIME...AND TSTM COVERAGE WILL LIKELY INCREASE THROUGH LATE AFTN. EFFECTIVE SHEAR OF 30 TO 40 KTS WILL PROMOTE SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS...AND A TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED AND A WW IS POSSIBLE PRIOR TO 21Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS THE WW AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CLUSTERS OF SVR TSTMS WERE IN PROGRESS AT 2030Z ACROSS MAINLY THE SRN/ERN PORTIONS OF WW 340 WITH REPORTS OF UP TO GOLFBALL-SIZE HAIL AND ISOLATED SVR WIND GUSTS. THE OVERALL ENVIRONMENT REMAINS SUPPORTIVE OF A CONTINUED SVR THREAT WITH MOD-STRONG SFC-BASED INSTABILITY...WITH STRONGER EFFECTIVE SHEAR /30-35 KTS/ ACROSS THE NRN HALF OF WW AREA IN ASSOCIATION WITH REMNANT MCV OVER SRN WI. A SFC BOUNDARY EXTENDS SWD FROM A WEAK SFC LOW OVER CENTRAL WI INTO NWRN IL...AND ADDITIONAL SVR TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE OVER WRN PORTIONS OF WW AREA THROUGH 02Z. WHERE TSTMS MERGE INTO ONE OR MORE CLUSTERS...A MORE CONCENTRATED WIND DAMAGE THREAT MAY EXIST. ..BUNTING.. 06/21/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE LEE TROUGH AND LOW ARE DEEPENING OVER THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS IN ADVANCE OF AN APPROACHING UPPER-LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH. THOUGH CONVECTION HAS STRUGGLED INITIALLY OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF CO...BETTER MOISTURE/INSTABILITY OVER THE PLAINS SHOULD SUPPORT STORMS AS THEY MOVE EWD. CONVECTIVE INITIATION ALSO APPEARS PLAUSIBLE ALONG THE SURFACE TROUGH AXIS...AS SUPPORTED BY THE BOUNDARY-LAYER CUMULUS FIELD NEAR THE CO/KS BORDER. GIVEN DEEP-LAYER SHEAR OVER 30 KTS /AS SAMPLED BY THE PLATTEVILLE CO PROFILER/...ORGANIZED STORMS WITH THE THREAT OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR SEVERE HAIL AND WIND GUSTS IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE TO INCREASE ACROSS MUCH OF CENTRAL SOUTH DAKOTA THROUGH THE 00-02Z TIME FRAME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IS NOW WELL UNDERWAY...WITH VIGOROUS THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY CONTINUING TO INCREASE IN THE VICINITY OF THE SURFACE TROUGH. THIS INCLUDES RECENT NEW DEVELOPMENT TO THE WEST AND SOUTHWEST OF PIERRE. IT APPEARS THAT NEW STORMS WILL BEGIN TO FORM ALONG THE TROUGH TO THE NORTHWEST OF PIERRE SHORTLY...WITH GROWING/CONSOLIDATING COLD POOLS EVENTUALLY CONTRIBUTING TO FURTHER UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH ACROSS CENTRAL SOUTH DAKOTA THROUGH THE 00-02Z TIME FRAME. WITH VERY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SUPPORTING LARGE CAPE... CONSIDERABLE FURTHER CONVECTIVE INTENSIFICATION APPEARS POSSIBLE...PARTICULARLY WITH DEEP-LAYER SHEAR BECOMING MODERATELY STRONG WITH STRENGTHENING OF MID-LEVEL FLOW. VERY LARGE HAIL IS POSSIBLE IN STRONGEST STORMS INTO EARLY EVENING...AND THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONG DOWNBURST WINDS IS LIKELY TO INCREASE DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS WELL. ..KERR.. 06/21/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE WIND/HAIL THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS WW 340. DOWNSTREAM AREAS OF NRN INDIANA AND FAR SWRN MI ARE BEING MONITORED FOR WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTM ACTIVITY ACROSS WW 340 HAS LARGELY CONGEALED INTO MULTIPLE QUASI-LINEAR STRUCTURES...WITH THE STRONGEST ACTIVITY CURRENTLY OBSERVED FROM COU TO NORTH OF STL IN MISSOURI AND ACROSS NRN IL...INCLUDING THE CHICAGO METRO AREA...WHERE DAMAGING WINDS HAVE BEEN REPORTED IN THE LAST HOUR. WHILE EFFECTIVE SHEAR DECREASES WITH SWWD EXTENT...MODERATE INSTABILITY ACROSS E-CNTRL MO/W-CNTRL IL WILL LIKELY SUSTAIN ONGOING ACTIVITY FOR THE NEXT 2-3 HRS...WITH SOME THREAT POTENTIALLY WORKING INTO THE STL METRO BY 00Z. ACROSS NRN IL...THE TSTM COMPLEX IS MOVING SEWD IN AN ENVIRONMENT THAT IS LESS UNSTABLE COMPARED TO FURTHER SOUTH...BUT WITH STRONGER EFFECTIVE SHEAR OF 30-40 KTS AS DEPICTED BY OBJECTIVE MESOANALYSIS AND LOT VWP. WHILE THIS COMPLEX HAS WEAKENED SOMEWHAT IN THE LAST 30 MINUTES...SOME REJUVENATION IS POSSIBLE ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE LAKE IN SWRN MO/NRN IND...WHERE THE ATMOSPHERE REMAINS MOIST AND UNSTABLE WITH SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED CONVECTION. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED IN THIS AREA FOR POSSIBLE DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE. TSTMS ACROSS E-CNTRL IL HAVE WEAKENED CONSIDERABLY IN THE LAST HOUR AND DO NOT APPEAR TO POSE MUCH DOWNSTREAM SEVERE THREAT INTO W-CNTRL INDIANA...GIVEN WEAKER MOISTURE/INSTABILITY AND DIFLUENT LOW-LEVEL FLOW IN THIS AREA. ..DEAN.. 06/21/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE EVOLUTION OF AN INCREASINGLY ORGANIZED MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM STILL APPEARS POSSIBLE THROUGH THE 02-04Z TIME FRAME. A NEW WW MAY BE NEEDED ACROSS EAST OF WW 341.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY HAS GENERATED MULTIPLE SIGNIFICANT COLD POOLS WHICH ARE ADVANCING GENERALLY EASTWARD BENEATH WEAK TO MODEST WESTERLY DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW. OUTFLOW ASSOCIATED WITH THE LEAD CLUSTER...NOW PROGRESSING INTO WEST CENTRAL MINNESOTA /TOWARD THE ALEXANDRIA AREA/ CURVES BACK TO THE WEST OF WATERTOWN SD... INTO AREAS WEST NORTHWEST OF HURON...WHERE AN INTERSECTION WITH A CONGLOMERATION OF EASTWARD ADVANCING OUTFLOW MAY FOCUS THE MOST INTENSE NEW/CONSOLIDATING CONVECTION THROUGH 02-04Z. THIS IS GENERALLY ON THE SOUTHERN FRINGE OF 30+ KT WESTERLY 500 MB FLOW...WHERE VERTICAL SHEAR IS STRONGEST IN ASSOCIATION WITH AN AREA OF ENHANCED SOUTHERLY 850 MB FLOW /UP TO 30 KT/. MID/UPPER SUPPORT FOR THE MAINTENANCE OF CONVECTION THIS EVENING REMAINS UNCLEAR...BUT A CONTINUING MODEST INFLOW OF MODERATE TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR APPEARS POSSIBLE AT LEAST AS FAR EAST AS THE INTERSTATE 29 CORRIDOR OF EAST CENTRAL NORTH DAKOTA. AND IT DOES APPEAR THAT THERE IS STILL TIME FOR FURTHER UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH INTO AN INCREASINGLY ORGANIZED MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM...WITH A MORE SUBSTANTIVE WIND GUST THREAT...IN ADDITION TO A CONTINUING RISK FOR LARGE HAIL. ..KERR.. 06/22/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND HAIL CONTINUES ANOTHER COUPLE OF HOURS. HOWEVER...THIS THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BECOME SUFFICIENTLY MARGINAL AND ISOLATED THAT THE NEED FOR ANOTHER WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST RAPID REFRESH SUGGESTS THAT THE BELT OF ENHANCED SOUTHERLY 850 MB FLOW /20-30 KT/ IS IN THE PROCESS OF SHIFTING NORTH NORTHEASTWARD OUT OF EASTERN SOUTH DAKOTA. AS THIS CONTINUES...THERE APPEARS LITTLE SUPPORT FOR SUBSTANTIVE INTENSIFICATION OF THE REMNANT ONGOING CONVECTIVE SYSTEM AS IT ADVANCES ACROSS THE SIOUX FALLS AREA INTO SOUTHWESTERN MINNESOTA AND NORTHWESTERN IOWA BY 06-07Z. ISOLATED STRONG CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT DOES PERSIST WITHIN THE LARGER CONVECTIVE SYSTEM...AND A STRONG DOWNBURST OR TWO MAY NOT YET BE OUT OF THE QUESTION BEFORE ACTIVITY WEAKENS LATER TONIGHT. HOWEVER...THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BECOME INCREASINGLY MARGINAL AND ISOLATED AS ACTIVITY SPREADS EAST OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 344. ..KERR.. 06/22/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
